preconditions.description: There are exactly 5 rows of input.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(line) <= 11 for line in input_lines)
preconditions.description: Each row represents one blimp registration code with length between 1 and 11.

preconditions.expression: all(line.isupper() or '0' <= c <= '9' or c == '-' for line in input_lines for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each character in a registration code is an uppercase letter, a digit, or a dash.

postconditions.expression: output_line == 'HE GOT AWAY!' or re.match(r'^\d+( \d+)*$', output_line)
postconditions.description: The output is either 'HE GOT AWAY!' or a string of space-separated integers indicating the rows with CIA blimps.
